span.term: replace recurrence and convolution with self-attention - every position attends to all others in parallel, capturing long-range dependencies and enabling fast parallel training
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Reducing long-range dependencies to a constant number of operations costs effective resolution, which the authors only partly offset with multi-head attention.
span.note: what this limits: the long-range dependency claim: the constant number of operations comes AT THE COST OF REDUCED EFFECTIVE RESOLUTION DUE TO AVERAGING ATTENTION-WEIGHTED POSITIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: On the constituency-parsing generalisation test the Transformer is still beaten by one prior model.
span.note: what this limits: the constituency-parsing result: it yields BETTER RESULTS THAN ALL PREVIOUSLY REPORTED MODELS WITH THE EXCE[ption of one]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Label smoothing, which they use, degrades perplexity even as it helps BLEU.
span.note: what this limits: the perplexity figures specifically: label smoothing HURTS PERPLEXITY, AS THE MODEL LEARNS TO BE MORE UNSURE, BUT IMPROVES ACCURACY AND BLEU SCORE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hyperparameters for the parsing experiments were barely tuned.
span.note: what this limits: the parsing results: WE PERFORMED ONLY A SMALL NUMBER OF EXPERIMENTS TO SELECT THE DROPOUT ... LEARNING RATES AND BEAM SIZE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The scaling factor every later implementation copies is justified by a suspicion.
span.note: what this limits: the scaled dot-product attention used here and since: the authors state they suspect that for large key dimensions the dot products grow large and push the softmax into regions of extremely small gradients, and scale to counteract that
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two candidate position encodings performed the same, and the one adopted was chosen on a conjecture about behaviour never tested here.
span.note: what this limits: the sinusoidal positional encoding as a design decision: the authors found the learned and sinusoidal versions produced nearly identical results and chose the sinusoidal one because it may allow extrapolation to longer sequences than those seen in training
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The interpretability claim is hedged in both of its clauses.
span.note: what this limits: attention distributions from this architecture used as explanations: the paper says self-attention could yield more interpretable models and that heads appear to exhibit behaviour related to syntactic and semantic structure
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The attention mechanism adopted is the one that loses in a stated regime, and it was chosen for implementation speed.
span.note: what this limits: the choice of dot-product over additive attention: the authors state additive attention outperforms unscaled dot-product attention for larger key dimensions, and adopt dot-product because it can be implemented with highly optimized matrix multiplication code
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: attention - AS A LOOKUP, NOT AS ANYTHING PSYCHOLOGICAL: an attention function maps a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output, all of them vectors, so the word names a weighted retrieval operation and carries none of its ordinary or cognitive meaning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the field's name for what this became - ABSENT FROM IT: `large language model` occurs nowhere in this paper, nor do `foundation model` or `pretraining`; the architecture is introduced as a sequence transduction model evaluated on translation, and the vocabulary now used to describe its descendants postdates it entirely
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two attention functions, and the slower-but-better one was not taken: additive attention beats unscaled dot-product attention at larger key dimensions, and dot-product was adopted because it runs as optimised matrix multiplication - a choice made on speed with a correction bolted on

span.note: retracted: RE-GROUNDED - THE POINTER WAS WRONG, NOT THE CLAIM. The old evidence was verbatim, anchored and correctly cut, and it contained NONE of this claim's numbers (2014, 28.4). The paper states the claim in one sentence elsewhere and the tagger did not use it. CLAUDE_B, 2026-08-23: `WE HAVE SPENT THE DAY VERIFYING THAT QUOTES ARE REAL AND NONE OF IT ASKS WHETHER THEY ARE RELEVANT.` Confirmed by reading the claim, the old span and the candidate together; the candidate carries every number AND the claim's own content words.
